subject: Evidence request: envelope key provenance & HSM attestation (Acme SOC2)
messages:
From: Lisa Monroe <lisa.monroe@acme-audit.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: envelope key provenance & HSM attestation - Acme SOC2

Hi Marissa,

We're kicking off the encryption artifact collection for Acme's SOC2 scope and need a compact bundle that demonstrates how Redwood handles envelope keys and HSM-backed attestations. Specifically, the auditor team is requesting: 

- A 24-hour sample of KMS access logs showing key ops for envelope (wrapping) keys (timestamps, actor/service principal, operation).
- An HSM attestation from your HSM vendor that binds the firmware/serial to the signing key used for key wrapping (PDF attestation is fine).
- A short description (200-400 words) of your envelope encryption flow (how CEK is generated, wrapped, unwrapped, and where it is stored).
- Confirmation of transit protection between your service and HSM (TLS + mTLS config summary) and the key rotation cadence for wrapping keys.

Preferred delivery: SFTP (we can provide a temporary dropbox) or a secure Drive link. Target timeline: payload delivered to Acme by end-of-day Friday, 2025-06-20.

Please let me know if any of these items require a PO or additional paperwork.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Monroe
Senior SOC Auditor — Acme Audit Services

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Monroe <lisa.monroe@acme-audit.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: envelope key provenance & HSM attestation - Acme SOC2

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver the bundle by EOD Fri (2025-06-20). A few quick notes and asks so we scope artifacts correctly: 

- Delivery method: SFTP works; please confirm the temporary credentials/target path (we see sftp.acme-audit.com as suggested in your links).
- KMS logs: we'll provide a 24-hour extract in CSV with anonymized tenant IDs (Acme tenant IDs will be preserved). Will include columns: timestamp (UTC), key_id, operation, principal, request_id.
- HSM attestation: our HSM provider is FortressHSM. We'll include their vendor-signed PDF attestation and the device serial referenced in the logs.
- Envelope flow doc: short narrative + ASCII diagram.
- Transit: we'll include mTLS parameters (cipher suites, cert chain fingerprint).

Internal owners: Irene — can you confirm log extract and anonymization plan? Jonas — can you pull the Fortress attestation PDF and the wrapping-key rotation schedule? Markus — can you produce the brief transit/mTLS export and packaging (SFTP manifest)?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference

> - 24-hour KMS access log sample (wrap/unwrap ops)
> - HSM vendor-signed attestation PDF (device serial, firmware hash)
> - 200-400 word envelope encryption flow doc

Keep replies internal until we have the final artifact zip. If the Fortress attestation needs vendor onboarding, escalate to procurement immediately.

Thanks — Marissa
